stratagems.name: Command Re-roll
stratagems.description: Re-roll one Hit roll, Wound roll, Damage roll, saving throw, Advance roll, Charge roll, Desperate Escape test, or Hazard test.

stratagems.name: Counter-Offensive
stratagems.description: Interrupt the combat sequence immediately after an enemy unit has fought to fight with one eligible unit from your army.

stratagems.name: Rapid Ingress
stratagems.description: Your unit can arrive from Reserves as if it were the Reinforcements step of your Movement phase, during your opponent's turn.

stratagems.name: Heroic Intervention
stratagems.description: Declare a counter-charge with one eligible unit after an enemy unit completes a charge move within 6" of that unit.

stratagems.name: Smokescreen
stratagems.description: Target unit gains the Benefit of Cover and the Stealth ability until the end of the phase.

stratagems.name: Tank Shock
stratagems.description: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range after completing a Charge move; roll dice equal to your vehicle toughness and inflict mortal wounds on 5+.

stratagems.name: Go to Ground
stratagems.description: Target unit gains the Benefit of Cover and a 6+ invulnerable save until the end of the phase.

stratagems.name: Grenade
stratagems.description: Select one enemy unit within 8" and visible to this unit; roll six D6, each 4+ causes 1 mortal wound.

abilities.name: Icon of Obstinacy
abilities.description: Each time an attack targets this model's unit, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than or equal to the Toughness characteristic of that unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

abilities.name: Rampart
abilities.description: Once per battle, at the start of any phase, this model can use this ability. If it does, until the end of the phase, this model has a 2+ invulnerable save.

abilities.name: Leader
abilities.description:
This model can be attached to the following units:

■ TERMINATOR ASSAULT SQUAD
■ TERMINATOR SQUAD

abilities.name: Inspiring Commander
abilities.description: If you include this model in your army, until the end of the battle, non-Character models in Terminator Assault Squad and Terminator Squad units from your army have an Objective Control characteristic of 2 while they are not Battle-shocked.

abilities.name: Signum Array
abilities.description: While this model is leading a unit, ranged weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability.

abilities.name: Siege Captain
abilities.description: Each time this model makes an attack that targets a Monster, Vehicle, or Fortification unit, improve the Strength, Armour Penetration and Damage characteristics of that attack by 2.

abilities.name: Leader
abilities.description:
This model can be attached to the following units:

■ AGGRESSOR SQUAD
■ ERADICATOR SQUAD
■ HEAVY INTERCESSOR SQUAD

abilities.name: Oath of Rynn
abilities.description: Once per battle, at the start of either player’s Command phase, this model can use this ability. When it does, until the end of the turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of weapons equipped by models in this model’s unit.

abilities.name: To the Last
abilities.description: While this model is leading a unit, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll if that unit is below its Starting Strength, and add 1 to the Wound roll as well if that unit is Below Half-strength.
